exampleEn: I need to stay on track to finish this project on time.
exampleKo: 나는 이 프로젝트를 제시간에 끝내기 위해 순조롭게 진행해야 해.
gameExamples: We have to stay on track if we want to meet our goals this quarter.
To achieve success, it's important to stay on track with your personal development plan.
Setting small milestones can help you stay on track during a long journey.
